Name: Overslept - sleep in after passing out
Author: heyitsmads
Description:
Inspired by the pass out mechanic in [url=https://www.fieldsofmistria.com]Fields of [/url][color=#fb923c]Mistria[/color], and the more complex [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53306]Sleep In[/url] mod, Overslept makes you sleep in the day after passing out at 2am rather than losing money and energy. 

There's a few reasons why you might want this mechanic instead of the vanilla pass out behaviour:
[list]
[*]Losing time stays a penalty the entire game, whereas its trivial to regain some energy or lost money later in the game[/*]
[*]It's more immersive — why are the good people of Pelican Town robbing the farmer every time they stay out too late??[/*]
[/list]The wake up time and disabling of vanilla penalties is fully configurable.

Should be compatible with just about anything.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks OrangeJuiceStain for making Sleep In which gave me the idea for porting the overslept mechanic from FoM. If you want more complex sleep in features (sliding scale of overslept times based on when you go to bed, custom buffs and debuffs, etc) then go use their mod! Overslept is intentionally simple and vanilla-like.

Manifest.Name: Overslept
Manifest.Description: Sleep in after a 2am collapse instead of losing energy and money.
